lead_summary:

== Points of Interest ==
=== Museum ===
In the north of the city is a museum with various exhibits.

==== Reviving Fossils ====
On the eastern side of the museum is a lab where after defeating {{Gym|3}}, the player can revive [[bulbapedia:Fossil|fossil Pokémon]], except for {{ItemIcon|OLDAMBER}} Old Amber. Only one fossil can be revived at a time, and it takes [[Time|4 hours]] for each fossil.

==== Metronome Move Tutor ====
Within the lab on the eastern side of the museum is a scientist who will teach [[bulbapedia:Metronome (move)|Metronome]] for free.

==== Mud-Slap Move Tutor ====
A scientist in the second floor of the museum will, after finishing his quiz, teach [[bulbapedia:Mud-Slap (move)|Mud-Slap]] for free.

==== Old Amber Event ====
Using Cut to enter the back of the lab in the museum, the player will find a scientist who needs help to retrieve an {{ItemIcon|OLDAMBER}} Old Amber from [[Viridian Forest]]. After helping her, the player will receive the {{ItemIcon|OLDAMBER}} Old Amber, which can be revived at the lab on [[Cinnabar Island]].
